text:
Alex: Heads-up — pushed a new grafana panel 'prefixcache diffdrive' under /dashboards/prefix/diffdrive. Shows per-model/per-route token-saved deltas when toggling kernel selection and batch heuristics. Quick link: https://grafana.redwood/d/pfx-diffdrive
Priya: Nice. What's the primary axis? token-saved or hit-rate?
Alex: token-saved by default, with hover to see hit-rate and avg latency. We added a 'kernel-tag' breakdown (triton-v1, cuopt, fallback-vcpu).
Sam: I see a weird dip for model rwd-3b on /chat/stream when kernel=cuopt & batcher=adaptive. ~12% drop in hit-rate vs triton-v1
Jia: Can you paste the prom query? I'll run more slices.
Alex: Sure:
```
sum by (model,route,kernel) (increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[6h]))
/ sum by (model,route,kernel) (increase(prefix_cache_requests_total[6h]))
```
Sam: I profiled one trace — batching heuristics fold windows into slightly different key normalization order. KV keys got reordered (timestamp munging) for some routes. That explains miss patterns.
Priya: Did the kernel switch change request serialization? I thought key hashing was stable.
Sam: kernel change itself not, but the adaptive batcher reorders inputs to optimize latency; we didn't re-run the key-normalizer after reorder. TODO: ensure key-normalizer runs post-batch-reorder.
Irene: deploy-bot: canary rollout v0.12.3 to runtime-cluster-2 triggered by @alex — status: success :white_check_mark:
Alex: Added an adhoc panel 'delta-hist' showing distribution of token-saved per-tenant. Found 3 tenants with negative savings (token increase).
Nate: Which tenants? We should pause cuopt on them in Dedicated.
Alex: Tenants: AcmeCorp, BrightLeaf, Queryly — details in panel. Action: @Sam to add a tenant slice sampler to the dashboard (5/5) and @Jia to write an alert when token-saved < -1000 tokens/hr.
Sam: On it. I'll also add a small sample that reproduces reordering locally.
Jia: For alert, using this prom query:
```
sum by (tenant)(increase(prefix_cache_token_delta_total[1h])) < -1000
```
Priya: Also adding a column for 'kernel_latency_p50' so product can see perf tradeoffs.
Alex: TL;DR: observability found regression tied to batcher+kernel interaction causing cache-key order variance. Fix: run key-normalizer after batch reorder + add kernel-tag in telemetry. Rolling out patch now.
Sam: I'll open a tiny PR with tests and a reproducer.
Alex: Thanks all :rocket:
